stand_ins: clear air only: clouds, haze and dust along the limb (which dim and change an eclipse a great deal) are not counted yet
the air is one temperature all the way up (an exponential air with the surface's scale height)
the colour is the middle of the shadow; the shadow's edge, where the light skims higher, is not worked yet
why: Starlight skimming the air 0.5 to 3.7 km above the ground is bent by about 0.85° and reaches the middle of the shadow 384400 km behind.
Along that grazing path the air scatters blue light away far more than red: 1% of green light gets through, so the shadow glows #FF5500.
